title: DEF-001 verify: compose.yaml exists and defines the required services
objective: Verify root compose.yaml now exists and defines backend, frontend, postgres, redis (celery-worker/beat + minio optional) per design §16.1; scripts can reference it.
steps: Read compose.yaml; verify presence and service definitions (frontend, backend, postgres, redis; celery/minio per plan).
Verify healthchecks/dependency ordering for backend readiness and non-root containers per design §16.2.
Boot verification (docker compose up) remains Docker-dependent — execute if a Docker environment is available; otherwise record BLOCKED for the boot portion.
expected_result: compose.yaml present with all required services wired (env via .env, healthchecks, volumes for postgres/media); closes DEF-001 pending boot test.
automation_status: file-inspection automatable; boot blocked without Docker

title: DEF-002 verify: root .env.example present with placeholder-only values
objective: Verify root .env.example exists, documents every required variable, and contains no real secrets.
steps: Read .env.example; verify all variables referenced by compose.yaml and settings are present with placeholders.
Scan for secret-looking real values (none allowed).
expected_result: Complete placeholder-only env example present; closes DEF-002.

title: DEF-003 verify: Idempotency-Key works on asset create (re-run of TC-FR-003-06)
objective: Verify POST /assets honors Idempotency-Key: replay returns original response without duplicates; conflicting payload with same key rejected.
preconditions: Cycle-2 idempotency implementation delivered; operator session.
steps: Repeat identical request; compare response and asset count.
Repeat with same key + different payload; expect rejection per contract.
Verify IdempotencyRecord scoping (per user+endpoint) and 24h TTL presence in implementation/tests.
expected_result: Replay-safe create; conflict detection on key reuse with different payload; closes DEF-003 for asset create (workflow endpoints covered in their own suites).

title: DEF-004 verify: backend uv.lock committed and consistent with pyproject
objective: Verify backend/uv.lock (or documented equivalent pin file) exists and matches pyproject dependencies.
test_data: uv.lock presence; spot-check key packages (django, djangorestframework, psycopg)
steps: Check for backend/uv.lock; if an alternative (requirements lock) is delivered instead, verify README documents it per ADR policy.
Spot-check locked versions satisfy pyproject ranges.
expected_result: Committed lockfile or documented equivalent; closes DEF-004 when present; remains open (Low) if still absent with documented reason.

title: DEF-005 verify: frontend lint is warning-free
objective: Verify npm lint now reports 0 errors AND 0 warnings (13 self-closing warnings fixed).

title: DEF-006 verify: reference-data DELETE deactivates (or is blocked) for in-use values
objective: Verify reference-data delete semantics: deleting an in-use value is blocked (409 with message) or performs deactivation, never hard delete of referenced records; unused values behave per documented contract; action audited.
preconditions: admin session; a department referenced by an existing asset; an unused reference record.
test_data: DELETE on in-use department; DELETE on unused record
steps: DELETE in-use department → expect 409 (or documented deactivation response); verify record still referenced and asset intact.
DELETE unused record → verify documented behavior (deactivate vs delete).
Verify audit event records the action.
Verify deactivated values no longer selectable in create/edit flows but remain on historical records.
expected_result: BR-004 enforced: no hard delete of in-use reference data; deactivate-not-delete semantics; audited; historical references intact. Closes DEF-006.
